shared_elements: human figure(s) depicted frontally or in profile
relief carving of a garment/body with incised detail
horizontal registers or bands of decoration
circular/disc motifs (rosette-like in B's band, disc on A's chest)
justification: Both depict human figures in relief with incised surface detail, and both include disc/rosette-like circular motifs and horizontal banding, but these are generic conventions. A is a single monolithic figure with a schematic head, torso and large chest disc rendered in the round, while B is a repeated procession of many identically posed standing figures in profile arranged in stacked registers, holding weapons and touching one another — a wholly different compositional scheme.
